---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Ashlan Guengerich"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-storms

# Filter to the three main storm types, count distinct storms per year and status, and fill missing year/status pairs with 0
storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  mutate(status = fct_relevel(status, "tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  summarize(n_storms = n_distinct(name), .by = c(year, status)) |>
  complete(year, status, fill = list(n_storms = 0)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_storms, fill = status)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Named Atlantic Storms per Year by Storm Type",
    subtitle = "Annual count of tropical depressions, tropical storms, and hurricanes",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type",
    caption = "Source: NOAA Atlantic hurricane database (dplyr::storms)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: print-storms
#| cache: true

storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-pressure-wind

# Map color to storm status and use alpha = 0.3 so overlapping observations remain visible
storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Atmospheric Pressure vs. Wind Speed in Recent Atlantic Storms",
    subtitle = "Stronger winds correspond to lower central pressure across storm statuses (2000–present)",
    x = "Maximum Sustained Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Atmospheric Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Storm Status",
    caption = "Source: NOAA Atlantic hurricane database (dplyr::storms)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
